questions.question: What did Moses promise God would raise up like himself?
What practices were forbidden as detestable to the LORD?
options: Divination, sorcery, and consulting the dead
Fasting, mourning, and the shaving of the head
questions.answer: Divination, sorcery, and consulting the dead

questions.question: A prophet whose words did not come true was not speaking from the LORD.
"The LORD your God will raise up for you a _____ like me," Moses said.
Israel was not to practice divination or consult the _____ (mediums of the dead).
